exclusions: Source items or observations outside the frozen UTC window
Silent promotion of source wording into factual certainty
Counting repetitions, summaries, or common upstream publications as independent evidence
Precise current operational positions, targeting-enabling detail, unsupported causality, or unsupported forecasts
definition_of_done: Only merged observations produced by the three declared dependencies were used as evidence
All dependency observations were editorially reviewed and assigned a justified terminal editorial status suitable for claim evidence
Testable propositions were normalized into claim records with explicit observation evidence relations and preserved attribution and qualifiers
Upstream lineage and evidence independence were resolved before assigning outcomes or confidence
A non-empty set of approved claims and approved assessments was produced; unsupported propositions remained unverified, contested, rejected, or were omitted with an explicit coverage gap
Claim and assessment records conform to repository schemas and remain traceable to exact observation IDs
A queue proposal receipt was persisted; an empty proposals array is acceptable because the downstream graph is pre-materialized
Two separate self-review rounds passed and a receipt was persisted
